abstract: A 28-year-old man visited our hospital with a complaint of left testicular pain and swelling. Left orchiectomy was performed, and its pathological finding was embryonal carcinoma (seminoma in a small portion). Though no sign of metastasis was detected and the serum tumor markers, alpha-fetoprotein, and beta-human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) decreased in value as expected, he has undergone two courses of chemotherapy (PVB regimen). Twenty months after operation the patient found contralateral testicular induration, and serum beta-HCG was abnormally high, 36.0 ng/ml. We performed right orchiectomy. The pathology revealed pure seminoma. He has been followed up without adjuvant therapy.
abstract_ja: 28歳男性が左精巣の疼痛と腫脹を主訴に受診した。左精巣摘除術を施行し、病理学的所見は胎児性癌（一部にセミノーマ）であった。転移の所見は認められず、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGの血清腫瘍マーカーは期待どおり低下したが、PVB療法を2コース施行した。術後20か月で対側精巣に硬結が出現し、血清β-hCGは36.0 ng/mlと異常高値を示したため、右精巣摘除術を施行した。病理学的所見は純粋なセミノーマであった。補助療法は施行せず経過観察とした。
